Data Analyst, Paystack India — Feb 2026 - Present
At Paystack India, I analyze transaction and merchant datasets to improve onboarding and reduce payment failures. Developed Python ETL scripts using pandas to clean and aggregate event data for cohort analyses and to feed Looker explores; automated a weekly reporting pipeline that saved 6 hours/week of manual work. Performed ad-hoc SQL-backed analyses to support product experiments and pricing decisions.

Data Analyst, Swiggy — Jun 2024 - Jan 2026
At Swiggy, I partnered with operations and marketplace teams to improve delivery efficiency and partner retention. Created Power BI and Tableau dashboards tracking delivery time distributions, order cancellations, and partner performance; dashboards were used in daily ops reviews and helped reduce late deliveries by 12% in targeted zones. Wrote Python scripts using pandas to preprocess large order and telemetry datasets and to derive features for predictive models. Produced Excel-based KPI trackers for regional managers and worked with engineering to validate SQL queries and ensure data quality.
